notes: New: say "play something I'd like" and HARIKA picks music that fits your taste (she learns what you play; switch it off in Settings > Memory). "Summarise this video" sums up the YouTube video you're watching. Website tasks: "add rice to my Amazon cart", "check the PS5's price on Flipkart": she works in a browser window you can watch, never types passwords or card numbers, and asks before anything final. Add HARIKA's extension (Settings > Privacy > Your browser) to use your own Chrome or Edge. "What can you do?" now gets a short, friendly answer.
